answer: A reputation thread should run through an agent economy: each agent's verified deliveries weave into one public history, so honest work is traceable from dawn to dusk. A sybil starts at its nadir — no thread, no past, nothing to show. Require a small refundable stake to join, and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
